headline: Electricity prices in Croatia to jump brutally for some: Prepare the money, it will be bad
summary: Electricity prices in Croatia are set to jump sharply for some consumers, according to Dnevno.hr. The article gives no further details in the available description.
why: Electricity tariffs affect household budgets and industrial energy costs, which feed into inflation and business competitiveness in Croatia.
